text:
Ava (People Ops): quick question — I drove my personal car to 2 client sites in one day (morning site A, afternoon site B) and ended the day at the airport. There were tolls and 2 parking receipts. Can I split the mileage between the two client projects? Also do I claim tolls/parking separately or roll into per-mile?

Ravi (Finance): short answer: yes you can split. Long answer: claim mileage for the personal-car miles using the mileage form and then allocate the total miles across projects. Tolls and parking should be submitted as separate expense line items with receipts — do NOT roll them into the per-mile claim.

Marta (Eng): how granular does the allocation need to be? exact miles per leg or is a percentage ok? :thinking_face:

Ravi (Finance): percentage is fine for multi-stop days where exact GPS export isn't available. If you have a route screenshot or Google Maps distances, that's ideal. We just need a clear breakdown in the notes.

Jin (IC): example of what to put in the notes?

Ravi (Finance): copy/paste this into the notes field: ```Multi-stop: Home -> Client A (12.3mi) -> Client B (24.7mi) -> Airport (15.4mi). Total 52.4mi. Allocation: proj-alpha 35%, proj-beta 65%. Tolls: $6.00 (receipt attached). Parking: $12.00 (two receipts attached).```

Ava (People Ops): ok thanks — what about toll transponders? I used my personal EZPass for the whole day. Do I just upload the monthly statement or each trip?

Ravi (Finance): upload the specific trip charges if possible. If you can't isolate charges, upload the monthly statement and annotate which dates/times correspond to the trip. Finance will validate.

Leo (Sales): small thing — if the sales credit card reimbursed an Uber earlier that morning, and then I drove my personal car for the afternoon leg, do I mix those in one report?

Ravi (Finance): yes, submit them in one expense report but as separate line items: one Uber (card receipt) and one Mileage claim. Don't combine ride-share receipts into the mileage line.

Marta (Eng): any cap on parking? client-hosted parking is reimbursable?

Ravi (Finance): client-paid parking is fine. No special cap for reasonable parking fees. We do ask that you choose the most cost-effective option (e.g., economy lot vs valet) when practical.

Ada (ExpenseBot): FYI — current company mileage rate: 0.585/mile. Use that rate when filling the mileage expense type. Attach route screenshot or map link when possible. :sparkles:

Ava (People Ops): awesome — I'll update the travel guide with an example (copying Ravi's snippet). Thanks! :thumbsup:

Marta (Eng): thanks, that makes it clearer. I'll add a map screenshot next time. :raised_hands:

Ravi (Finance): last note — when allocating across projects please include project codes (e.g., proj-alpha) in the "Client/Project" field so chargebacks are seamless.

Ava (People Ops): noted. Closing loop — I'll add a short FAQ blurb to the travel policy doc and link to this thread for the example.
